Thanks, Vivek - great recap. A few answers from our side: 

- Procurement/payment: Our procurement team requires a PO for any invoiced SaaS purchase over $25k/year. We try to avoid corporate cards for larger contracts. So PO route is preferred.
- Finance contact: Tom Nguyen (cc'd) will be the finance sponsor who raises the PO and coordinates on payment terms.
- Budget owner / economic buyer: Erin Wallace (VP Product) owns the budget for this initiative. She will be the economic buyer for any multi-quarter commitment.
- Signatory: Legal prefers to have Procurement + Legal approval; they will route contracts to our GC for signature if the amount exceeds our delegated authority.

For marketplace, we are open to AWS Marketplace if it aligns with procurement rules, but our finance team has to confirm if they can consume metered charges - that may complicate PO flow. If using Marketplace could avoid a separate contract it would be attractive, but we need to confirm with Tom.

Tom - can you confirm whether Acme can accept Marketplace metered billing under a PO?

On timing - Thu 3/5 10-11am PT works for a short procurement sync for me and Tom. Happy to include Erin if you think it makes sense, or we can loop her after we have rough pricing and MSA.

Samantha
